onboarding.title: Welcome to 2FAir
onboarding.subtitle: Your 2FA codes, encrypted and kept only on this device. No account, no server.
onboarding.passkeyHint: Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key
onboarding.prfUnsupported: This passkey can't encrypt your vault in this browser. Use a passcode instead.
onboarding.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys aren't available in this browser. Use a passcode instead.
onboarding.backupBody: Use it when your passkey isn't available, for example in another browser or if you lose the device that holds it.
onboarding.skipWarning: Without a backup passcode, losing your passkey means losing access to your codes.

unlock.title: 2FAir is locked
unlock.lockedOut: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
unlock.resetBody: This permanently deletes every code stored on this device. If you have a backup file you can restore it afterwards.
unlock.passkeyTip: To unlock with Face ID or Touch ID, add a passkey in Settings.

home.emptyBody: Add your first 2FA account by scanning its QR code or entering the secret key.
home.passkeyNudgeBody: Use Face ID, Touch ID or Windows Hello instead of typing your passcode.

entry.label: Account
entry.secretInvalid: The secret key should be Base32 (letters A–Z and digits 2–7)
entry.periodInvalid: Use a period between 10 and 300 seconds

scan.title: Scan QR code
scan.hint: Point your camera at the 2FA QR code
scan.cameraError: Can't access the camera. Check the permission settings.
scan.drop: Drop an image here or click to choose one
scan.formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP or a screenshot
scan.noQr: No QR code found in this image
scan.notOtpauth: This QR code isn't a 2FA code
scan.badSecret: This QR code has an invalid secret key
scan.migration: Google Authenticator export codes aren't supported yet. Export accounts one at a time instead.

menu.deleteBody: Make sure you've turned off 2FA for this account or have another way to sign in. This can't be undone.

qr.title: Move to another app
qr.warning: Anyone who sees this QR code or secret can generate your codes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passkeysHint: Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key.
settings.keepOne: Keep at least one way to unlock
settings.autoLockHint: Lock 2FAir after this long without activity.
settings.backupHint: Your codes live only in this browser. Export an encrypted backup and keep it somewhere safe.
settings.importHint: Restore a 2FAir backup, or bring accounts over from another authenticator app.

format.backupHint: Password-protected. Restore it in 2FAir on any device.
format.linksHint: One link per line, for moving to another authenticator app. Not encrypted.

settings.linksWarning: Anyone who opens this file can generate your codes. Import it where you need it, then delete it.
settings.linksConfirm: I understand this file isn't encrypted
settings.backupPasswordHint: You'll need it to restore. At least 8 characters.
settings.importFileHint: A 2FAir backup (.json) or a text file with one otpauth:// link per line.
settings.skippedLinks_one: {{count}} link isn't a valid TOTP account and will be skipped
settings.skippedLinks_other: {{count}} links aren't valid TOTP accounts and will be skipped
settings.plaintextWarning: This file holds your secret keys unencrypted. Delete it once you've imported it.
settings.unsupportedFile: No accounts found. Choose a 2FAir backup or a text file of otpauth:// links.
settings.installHint: Add 2FAir to your home screen or dock for quick access.
settings.installIos: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
settings.resetHint: Delete all accounts and settings on this device.
settings.aboutBody: 2FAir works fully offline. Your codes never leave this device.
